<thought>To locate the correct retrosynthetic template for sulfonamide formation, I will search the template catalog using the functional group that is formed in the forward reaction: “sulfonamides”. This should return templates that break a sulfonyl‑chloride and amine bond to give a sulfonamide, which is the transformation we need.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CCN(S(=O)(=O)C)C",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
